title: How to complete all remaining csm-orchestrate adapter work without OpenCode sessions

tldr.content: Build three explicit execution boundaries: csm-build current-context handoff, csm-browse CDP/session adapter, and csm-autoresearch evaluator/sandbox adapter. Then prove them through the existing orchestrator control plane: exact approvals/digests, evidence entailment, durable terminal replay, UNKNOWN reconciliation, independent review, remediation, outcome evaluation, and package/CI gates. Do not use OpenCode SDK or CLI.

executiveSummary.content: The repository already has the control-plane seams, but the remaining adapters are not interchangeable. csm-build is instruction-led and must return typed work from the current agent context; csm-browse owns a token-gated browser session and CDP side effects; csm-autoresearch executes candidates under evaluator and sandbox trust rules. The adapters must normalize outputs without taking ownership of approvals, requirements, receipts, recovery, or final acceptance. A green unit suite alone is insufficient because current tests mostly exercise synthetic callbacks and helper seams.

keyFindings.content:
K1. supported: csm-build can integrate through the typed handoff already added, but a real csm-build lifecycle caller and registered output contract are still required. [R1]

K2. partially-supported: csm-browse can compose existing CDP/session libraries, but safety depends on token gates, session ownership, cleanup, URL/verb policy, and CDP-version testing, not composition alone. [R2][R5]

K3. partially-supported: csm-autoresearch can adapt trusted-local and generated modes only with explicit trust distinctions; trusted-local is not an OS sandbox and generated execution needs host-attested isolation. [R3][R6][R7]

K4. supported: Durable UNKNOWN/retry handling records ambiguity but cannot prove that an in-process or child operation stopped; adapters must provide cleanup/quiescence or remain reconciliation-required. [R4][R8]

K5. supported: The complete original goal also requires approval binding, exact evidence entailment, remediation graph semantics, independent final review, and held-out outcome evaluation. [R9][R10]

K6. supported: The OpenCode SDK is not a solution because it is still server/session based. [R11][R12]

detail-sections.content:
Build order:

1. csm-build handoff. Add/register csm-build-output/1 and map state/artifact descriptors into the orchestrator child receipt/evidence/artifact envelope. The caller supplies the current-context executor; it must use the orchestrator child identity, validated plan/inputs, scoped permissions, AbortSignal, and complete delivery evidence. Commit/push/deploy remain explicit authorizations owned by csm-build. Test real lifecycle entry, malformed delivery, wrong identity/digest, cancellation, workspace mutation, crash-after-write, and durable replay. [R1]

2. csm-browse adapter. Inject a narrow typed operation list, derive the child session ID, call ensure-browser/session/CDP libraries directly, forbid shared port 9222, and translate native csm-browse-evidence/1 descriptors into resolver-backed orchestrator artifacts plus csm-orchestrate-evidence/2. Enforce approved URL schemes, sensitive-operation permission, output caps, redaction, path containment, binary acknowledgement, and idempotent cleanup. Abort before dispatch must create no session; abort after a browser action is sent must be incomplete/reconciliation-required. Test target crash, daemon death, token revocation, PID reuse, cleanup ownership, and the actual bundled Chromium/CDP version. [R2][R5]

3. csm-autoresearch adapter. Validate the run contract and bind native run ID, orchestrator child ID, evaluator identity, source mode, candidate hash, policy digest, and artifact root. Call optimize() with an immutable evaluator-owned callback. trusted-local may run only under its explicitly weaker trusted-process policy; generated sources require a verified host sandbox with network/mount/credential/resource/descendant controls. Persist append-only ledger, report, manifest, quarantine, and rollback evidence before returning completion. Promotion remains human-approved. Timeout/cancellation after candidate dispatch is UNKNOWN until the evaluator/sandbox and artifacts reconcile. [R3][R6][R7]

4. Shared control-plane hardening. Require route-wide handler/adapter preflight before approval reservation, idempotency, progress, cursor, or dispatch intent. Bind capability, contract, handler, receipt/evidence schema, configuration, and request digests through approval, retry, cursor, terminal records, and replay. Persist complete child responses, not minimal statuses. Preserve exact requirement-to-signal evidence entailment, technical/functional gates, remediation insertion/revision/budget/cycle checks, and truly independent final review with frozen context and separate provenance. [R4][R9][R10]

5. Proof and release. Freeze the existing 12/8/10 evaluation split and add real route cases for csm-build, browse, autoresearch, refusal, incomplete, cancellation, malformed output, remediation, and review-required outcomes. Measure outcome status, requirement coverage, artifact lineage, effects, retries, latency, and redaction. Run source/payload parity, static no-OpenCode scan, Node 22 SQLite/WAL tests, full repository gates, and an independent final review. Do not count BLOCKED or skipped adapter cases as all-skill success. [R10]

recommendation.content: Implement in the five stages above, in order. The first executable milestone is a real csm-build caller handoff, because it establishes the current-context ownership model. Next add browse and autoresearch as separate adapters with separate threat models; do not create a generic adapter abstraction that hides their effects. Keep OpenCode removed and make absent adapters explicit BLOCKED/REQUIRES_REVIEW outcomes. Release only when the real route corpus, fault-injection matrix, durable replay, approval binding, independent review, package parity, and CI evidence all pass.

unverified-claims.content:
1. The actual external caller that constructs or should construct the csm-build handoff is outside this checkout; locate it before declaring integration complete.
2. The exact bundled Chromium version and CDP protocol edition used by csm-browse need runtime inspection.
3. The deployment host's namespace, cgroup, mount, network, credential, and descendant-containment guarantees for generated autoresearch candidates are not established by repository tests.
4. In-process final-review independence is governance-level separation, not process isolation; decide whether the threat model requires a separate process or a sufficiently isolated frozen-context executor.
5. SQLite/WAL evidence must be collected under Node 22 in CI or an equivalent environment; local Node 20 skips are not proof.

process-appendix.content: Tier: DEEP. Source mode: hybrid. Research tracks: csm-build current-context integration, csm-browse CDP/session adapter, csm-autoresearch evaluator/sandbox adapter, and end-to-end assurance. Four independent researchers returned repository and external-source evidence. One anti-anchored challenger downgraded safety/completeness claims; one judge scored factual accuracy 0.88, citation accuracy 0.79, completeness 0.62, clarity 0.93 and failed the draft on completeness. Remediation added durable store, approval binding, evidence entailment, remediation, review independence, and outcome-evaluation requirements. No implementation was performed. The finding is research evidence, not authorization to build.
